name: Shih Chien University Taipei M gym + N library + central court
model_year_basis: 2009 completed building; professional-publication photographs and NLSC2024-watermarked orthophoto, not a 2026 survey

sources.use: Built facade photographs; model photograph for supporting topology only.
Official building identity, completion date, stories and project data.
Published site plan and section, no numeric scale or elevations.
Building identifiers and current floor uses; not a dimensional survey.
PHOTO2 z19 3x3 georeferenced roof/court imagery; roof parallax acknowledged.

height_method: Original 2000x1414 section M width ~413px and lawn-to-roof ~360px; height/width ~0.872, cross-checked against orthophoto width and photographs. No measured elevations.
major_print_simplifications: Flat thick cap substitutes very shallow M crown
Thickened frames, rounded columns/stairs and blunt skylight caps
Low V-root gusset and deeper N stair support
Only shallow exterior descending access, no B1/B2 interior
redistribution: Source photographs, published drawings and reference boards are not included in the proposed public artifact. Rights were not verified. Only model-generated previews and source links should be distributed.
